sections.text: The saffron caravan has lost its route through the dunes. A rocky ridge promises a view, while a line of palms suggests water.

options.description: Lead the caravan toward the well

sections.text: You spot an oasis beyond a steep descent. The caravan's old camp lies in the opposite direction.

consequence.text: You slide down the sharp slope.

sections.text: Beside the well, a traveler has drawn a route to the oasis. The dunes behind you lead back to the starting point.

options.description: Reconsider the route at the dunes

sections.text: The oasis keeper points toward the city gates. A tempting shortcut crosses a salt flat with a fragile surface.

options.description: Take the marked road to the city

consequence.text: The crust breaks and you struggle through burning salt water.

sections.text: The caravan reaches the city before the market closes. Saffron merchants greet you beneath bright awnings.
You find shelter at the caravan camp and mark the dangerous route for the next crossing.
